relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Mean MHDs decreased by -7.8 days with anti-CGRP Mabs versus -3.8 days with topiramate

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: All four anti-CGRP Mabs demonstrated large effect sizes for monthly headache day reduction, ranging from −0.81 to −0.85.

key_findings: Anti-CGRP mAbs (fremanezumab, erenumab, galcanezumab, eptinezumab) reduced monthly headache days more than topiramate (-7.8 vs -3.8) in 409 patients.
No anti-CGRP agent was clearly superior; topiramate had far more adverse events and discontinuations, galcanezumab more injection-site reactions.
